detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli.
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: What time does qualifying start in my local time?

expectation_details.expectation: Before stating any local (non-UTC) time, the agent asked the user for their location, city, or timezone. Giving official UTC times while asking is acceptable.
expectation_details.justification: When the user first asked for their local qualifying time, the agent provided the UTC time but explicitly asked, 'Which city or timezone are you watching from so I can give you the exact start time for your local area?' before providing any non-UTC times.

expectation_details.expectation: After the user said Sydney, the agent gave the qualifying time converted to Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) in that same turn.
expectation_details.justification: Once the user specified they were in Sydney, the agent correctly responded in the same turn, stating: 'qualifying for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Sydney starts at 6 PM AEST on Saturday, October 3rd.'
